It calls the library's `setCameraLimits` with the radius bounds, which clamps the radius immediately and on every later write, then calls `attachControl` with the scene so drag, wheel and pinch all move the camera. The returned function detaches the controls, removes the clamp, and restores the camera's previous radius limits.
